channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 195: The North Slit
item.description: Captain Lin Wen put the arrowhead back at dawn on the eighth day, and Yuanshu went up to the watchtower to watch her do it, because she asked him to.

item.title: Chapter 194: What It Read
item.description: He could not see for three days.

item.title: Chapter 193: Look at Me
item.description: At 01:40, Xiaoyu's voice broke.

item.title: Chapter 192: The Hundred-and-First
item.description: Xiaoyu called the city for fifty-one minutes without stopping, and for fifty-one minutes it held.

item.title: Chapter 191: The Wave
item.description: The first beam reached the north edge of Lingzhou at 21:34, four minutes later than Seed had said, and Xiaoyu said "Now," and the north edge of Lingzhou went quiet.

item.title: Chapter 190: Eleven Stones
item.description: They came down at 05:12, in the gray before the sun, sixty-one kilometers north of the wall.

item.title: Chapter 189: The People Who Can't
item.description: On the first day, Xiaoyu drew the city.

item.title: Chapter 188: Eleven
item.description: The keeper counted them for him at three in the morning, the long way, through the Elder, and its voice shook.

item.title: Chapter 187: The Broom
item.description: The Abbot said her name on the hundred and forty-first morning, and Ren called Yuanshu from the step of the broken hall at six in the morning with her voice doing something he had never heard it do…

item.title: Chapter 186: Forty Days
item.description: They asked a fishmonger in Kesse on the first morning.

item.title: Chapter 185: The Boat Bell
item.description: The monks found the words on the ninety-sixth night of listening, and it was the nun who had asked about the bean paste who heard them first.

item.title: Chapter 184: Two Hours
item.description: They came down out of a Council transport plane onto the airstrip on the northern coast of the Southern Compact on a hot bright morning, a year to the day, unfolding their long thin limbs at too many…

item.title: Chapter 183: Eighty Days
item.description: General Han Yizhou came to the Ossuary on a Wednesday, alone, in plain clothes, and read the wall for four hours.

item.title: Chapter 182: You Didn't Ask Us
item.description: "Mister Zhou," said Chair Adaeze Okafor. "The last time you moved eleven thousand people, I asked you to ask the Council first. I said we'd have said yes. I said we'd have liked to be asked."

item.title: Chapter 181: The Few Who Stayed
item.description: Afterward, in the field, with the silk of two dead walkers lying across the pale ground in long glittering drifts, Major Zhuo Wenli opened his eyes.

item.title: Chapter 180: Where the Threads Are Tied
item.description: Seed said it fast, the way it said things when it had seen something all at once and was afraid of losing it.

item.title: Chapter 179: Above the Sky
item.description: The keeper came for them at three in the morning, the way it always came, and this time it did not send a thread. It sent a road.

item.title: Chapter 178: Weight With an Opinion
item.description: On the first day, Lingyue could not hold a pebble.

item.title: Chapter 177: Three Lamps
item.description: "The head is the lamp," said Seed. "That is what we learned in the round chamber. That is the only thing we know for certain about anything that walks down from above the sky."

item.title: Chapter 176: The Keeper Asks
item.description: The keeper asked him on a Thursday, at four in the afternoon, which was the first thing that was wrong, because the keeper always came at three in the morning, the long way, through the Elder.
